{{Libra}}
Libra 11 is the 291st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 11th day of Libra, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 42, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮11日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 291|Chapter 291]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152310}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Thursday]]
